### By the Same Word
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/same-word
Passage: 2 Peter 3:7
Points:
- People often view the predictability of nature as proof that God does not intervene in the world.
- Skeptics and false teachers use natural consistency to deny Christ’s return and excuse personal immorality.
- Historical events like creation and the global flood demonstrate that God actively judges disobedience.
- The universe exists and remains intact solely because God upholds it by His powerful word.
- God's providential preservation of the present world will culminate in a final judgment by fire.
- Realizing that God sustains all things should foster daily humility and reverence.

### Time with God - Oct. 14, 2009
Author: Time with God
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-oct-14-2009-11609737.html
Passage: 2 Peter 3:3-7
Points:
- The current world order is temporary, and God's promised day of judgment remains inevitable.
- Though long periods pass without apparent change, the God who created the world has the authority to end it.
- The historical destruction of the earth through the flood confirms the certainty of a future judgment by fire.
- Contemplating Christ's return as judge should compel believers to pray for and evangelize those who are lost.
